name: lightsout
description: Run chains of coding agents unattended, with mediated permissions and doubts you answer.
long_description: LightsOut orchestrates coding agents (Claude Code and Codex) inside a container on your machine. Launch a chain of tasks and it runs them unattended: it commits per task, runs your verify command, and stops to ask only when a decision is genuinely yours. This extension is a thin local bridge to the container's MCP endpoint at 127.0.0.1; nothing leaves your machine.

port.title: LightsOut port
port.description: The port the LightsOut container publishes on this machine. Leave 8484 unless you changed it.
